whatIs.title: What is the percentage calculator?
whatIs.description: It answers the eight most common percent questions at once: B% of A, ratio, percent change, sale price, original price from a sale price, stacked discounts, percentage points, and VAT-inclusive to net. No mode switching: change a number and every card updates, each with its formula and a copy button. Collect up to 6 valid results in page memory and copy or download the complete comparison as TXT.

howToUse.title: How to use
items: 1. Type a question in the top box, like '15% of 50000', '30000->40000' or '120000 30% off'. The matching card fills in and the answer appears right away.
2. Or type numbers directly into any card. Korean units like 5만 work too.
3. Choose decimal places (0-4) and Korean unit display, and toggle 'Show formula' to see the math.
4. Copy gives a plain number without commas, and the page URL reproduces your inputs when shared.
5. Use Add to comparison on a card to collect up to 6 results. Editing inputs keeps collected results unchanged; copy or download the full comparison to retain it.

tips.title: Tips
items: To get the net amount from a VAT-inclusive price, divide by 1.1. That is not the same as subtracting 10% (× 0.9).
Reverse discount: 70,000 after 30% off means an original price of 70,000 ÷ 0.7 = 100,000.
For investment returns or raises, put the before and after values into the percent change card.
Differences between rates (interest, approval ratings) are best stated in percentage points.

items.q: Is a 20% discount followed by a 10% discount the same as 30% off?
items.a: No. 20% off then 10% off equals 0.8 × 0.9 = 0.72, which is a 28% discount. Sequential percentage discounts do not simply add up.

items.q: What is the difference between percentage points (%p) and percent (%)?
items.a: Going from 3% to 5% is a '2 percentage point increase' but also roughly a '67% increase.' %p expresses the absolute difference; % expresses the relative change.
Results are displayed to two decimal places by default. You can change the decimal precision setting if you need more precise results.

items.q: Are collected results saved or included in a shared link?
items.a: No. Up to 6 results stay in page memory and disappear when you refresh or leave. The link reproduces the calculator inputs, not the comparison list. Use Copy all results or Download all as TXT to keep the contents.

items.q: Does the comparison calculate differences between different result types?
items.a: Each entry preserves its original inputs, display settings, unit, and formula. Results with different kinds or bases, such as rates and amounts, are not automatically ranked or subtracted. Clearing the comparison and resetting calculator inputs are separate actions.
